documents.title: Orion Operations Manual
chunks: Project Orion emergency response uses the amber protocol. Operators must enter code ZEPHYR-17 before isolating the primary control bus.
During Project Orion emergency response, the secondary containment checklist requires verification of the amber protocol before handoff.

documents.title: Orion Astronomy Notes
chunks: Orion is a prominent constellation near the celestial equator. Betelgeuse and Rigel are among its brightest stars, and the Orion Nebula lies in the sword.

documents.title: Harbor Finance Guide
chunks: The Harbor program budget is reviewed quarterly in March, June, September, and December. Finance leads publish variance notes after each review.

documents.title: Harbor Weather Log
chunks: Harbor weather observations record wind direction, wave height, visibility, and barometric pressure. Winter storms often bring strong northwest winds.

documents.title: Cedar Remote Work Policy
chunks: The Cedar team remote-work policy allows three remote days per week. Employees coordinate office days with their manager and team calendar.

documents.title: Cedar Botany Notes
chunks: Cedar trees are evergreen conifers in the genus Cedrus. Their needle-like leaves grow in clusters and their woody cones mature over time.

documents.title: Atlas Reactor Procedure
chunks: Atlas reactor shutdown safeguard MERIDIAN-LOCK requires operators to verify coolant isolation, shutdown sequence, and safeguard status before restart.
Atlas reactor shutdown safeguard QUARTZ-SEAL requires operators to verify containment pressure, shutdown sequence, and safeguard status before restart.

documents.title: Atlas Training Bulletin
chunks: Atlas reactor training covers shutdown terminology, operator communication, simulator drills, and general safeguard awareness for new staff.
